programme.title: Program of Study: Major: Computer Science
programme.degree: Bachelor of Science degree with a major in Computer Science (Paul G. Allen School, College of Arts and Sciences); capacity-constrained, direct first-year admission
programme.how_found: Search (official domain only) -> UW General Catalog 'Program of Study: Major: Computer Science' and admit.washington.edu/majors/computer-science/.
programme.notes: International first-year applicants: autumn only ('Winter/Spring: international first-year applications not accepted'). Official domain in kb_top100_list.json is uw.edu; the official site is www.washington.edu and all pages used here are on washington.edu. Owner ruling: US university without a CS-specific admissions page; the university-wide undergraduate admissions page is the source, scoped to the university.

english.notes: Table columns: TOEFL iBT (prior to Jan. 21, 2026) 76; TOEFL iBT (effective Jan. 21, 2026) 4.0; IELTS 6.0; Duolingo 110. 'English proficiency for international first-year applicants'. Alternatives: SAT EBRW 580 / ACT English 22. No per-section minimum. gpa.notes: No GPA minimum published for first-year applicants (holistic review). The catalog's 'Minimum 2.00 cumulative GPA in all CSE courses' is a graduation rule, not admission.
